idea.title: SchemaSync — Database migration CLI for SQLite/PostgreSQL

plan.tagline: CLI tool to sync SQLite/PostgreSQL schemas across environments with zero downtime.
plan.problem: Developers waste hours manually syncing database schemas between dev, staging, and production, risking data loss or downtime with complex tools.
plan.solution: Run 'schemasync add' to capture schema changes, then 'schemasync sync' to apply them safely. Works offline with --demo mode. No GUI needed—just CLI commands.
plan.target_market: Solo devs, indie hackers, and small teams building apps with SQLite/PostgreSQL who avoid complex migration tools.
plan.demo_script: Run 'schemasync --demo' to see a fake schema diff between dev and prod SQLite files, then sync it with one command.
plan.phuket_angle: Thai small businesses running SQLite-based POS systems (e.g., restaurants) can sync schema changes across branches without IT headaches.
